name: Correction: bar stays in the new row
wortlaut: Drag and drop does not work, the indicator for the bar is shown but the bar does not stay in the new row. Please fix
wortlautDeutsch: Das Drag und Drop funktioniert nicht, der Indikator für den Balken wird gezeigt aber der Balken bleibt nicht in der neuen Zeile. Bitte korrigieren
kurz: On release, the replanning now goes through the same access the subscribers use, and an older drag logic that is still active can no longer catch the drag; the exact cause is not confirmed, because a real mouse drag cannot be checked here and the script sends “umplanen” directly, so please test it once by hand.
